actions.reason: C0001 has coherent RNA-driven identity evidence (proliferation/EMT/coagulation program) with no technical confounding; cross-modal structure is weak but not incompatible, so it remains a defensible discovery-stage candidate for downstream validation.

C0002 shows coherent multi-modal identity evidence (RNA pathways plus coordinated CNV depletion and concordant mutation trends) with no technical confounding; internal structure is modest but not incompatible, supporting retention for downstream validation.

C0003 is defined by a strong, coherent BAP1 mutation enrichment with molecular-modality cross-modal support and no technical confounding; despite weak RNA/CNV signals, it is a defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0004 has a strong, coherent WXS-defined identity (VHL/PBRM1-wildtype) with WXS-dominated cross-modal support; the CT technical association does not directly confound the defining genomic signal, so retention for downstream validation is defensible.

C0005 shows coherent multi-modal identity evidence (metabolic RNA pathways, coordinated CNV gains, DST enrichment) with broad modality support and no technical confounding; small size limits precision but does not undermine retention.

C0006 has a coherent WXS-driven identity (universal VHL mutation, PBRM1 depletion) with high internal resampling stability and no technical confounding; weak RNA/CNV signals reflect limited power rather than contradiction.
C0007 lacks affirmative biological evidence in any modality, has only 4 members with non-estimable resampling stability, and no credible structural revision resolves this insufficiency.
